backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no methods or logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking an email-text update requirement to the ContactSection component.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files used for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining extensive OKLCH CSS variables for theming plus global background and text defaults.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component assembling all marketing sections with header and footer.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Footer: Footer with logo, copyright line using caffeine.ai, and a sustainability tagline.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Header: Responsive header with scroll-aware styling, smooth in-page navigation, mobile menu, and logo fallback handling.
frontend/src/components/marketing/logo.t: Exports the shared logo image path and alt text for consistent branding.
frontend/src/components/marketing/sectio: About section describing bagasse origins and three sustainability feature cards.
Benefits section presenting four product advantages and a stats panel highlighting natural, toxin-free qualities.
Renders a sustainability-focused section explaining compostability benefits and a step-by-step composting process with icons and styled content.
Provides a contact section with email and info cards, including links for inquiries and partnership details.
Implements an FAQ accordion with expandable questions and answers about product safety, usage, and composting.
Displays the hero banner with eco-friendly messaging, CTA buttons that scroll to sections, and a product image.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend queries are used.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a custom earthy color palette for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, custom fonts, colors, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: JSON file describing project metadata, versions, and an existing feature request to update a contact email.
